diagnosis: The checks C1, C2, and C4 passed because the lone decision-maker used default values and common practices that do not require the hidden information. Specifically, C1 and C2 were satisfied with the default scanner strength and imaging protocol, while C4 was satisfied by the automatic recording of authorization due to the payer's Saturday-only approval.

C1.why: The neurologic urgency changes the assignment from an open choice between North and Vale to Patient North, and the required study changes the protocol to contrast-enhanced cervical and thoracic spine MRI.

C2.why: The neurostimulator restriction changes the scanner from an unspecified MRI system to exactly 1.5 tesla and requires a documented device-representative safety check.

C4.why: The payer's Saturday-only approval changes the authorization field from unverified to true for the assigned examination.
